call_purpose: You wanted to offer monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page and send customers to your own thank-you page after purchase.

resolved.text: You added a yearly price, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show at checkout.
You set the after-purchase redirect to your own thank-you page, and your test purchase took you straight to it.

covered.text: We discussed how to add GST to your prices and mentioned that there is a tax setting for it.

customer_next_steps.text: Add your privacy policy link to the checkout footer.

support_next_steps.text: We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.
